description_en: Applies for a public endpoint for an AnalyticDB for MySQL Data Warehouse Edition (V3.0) cluster
description_zh: 为数仓版集群申请公网连接地址
kebab_example: aliyun adb allocate-cluster-public-connection --db-cluster-id am-bp278jg90000 --connection-string-prefix am-bp278jg90000.ads.aliyuncs.com --api-version 2019-03-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AllocateClusterPublicConnection

parameters.description_en: The Data Warehouse Edition Cluster ID of AnalyticDB for MySQL. You can call the [DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~) operation to retrieve all Data Warehouse Edition cluster IDs within the specified region.
parameters.description_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用[DescribeDBClusters](~~129857~~)接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID。
parameters.help_en: The Data Warehouse Edition Cluster ID of AnalyticDB for MySQL. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html operation to retrieve all Data Warehouse Edition cluster IDs within the specified region
parameters.help_zh:
数仓版集群ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/129857.html接口查看目标地域下所有数仓版集群的集群ID
parameters.name: db_cluster_id

parameters.description_en:
The prefix of the public endpoint.

*   The prefix must contain lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens (-). It must start with a lowercase letter.
*   The prefix can be up to 30 characters in length.
*   By default, the cluster name is used as the prefix of the public endpoint.
parameters.description_zh:
公网连接地址的前缀。
- 由小写字母开头，必须包含小写字母、数字和中划线（-）组成。
- 长度不超过30个字符。
- 默认使用集群名。
